uhttpd.help: uhttpd serves this interface. Changes here are applied with automatic rollback: if the browser can no longer reach the router, the old settings come back.
uhttpd.cert_help: Used for HTTPS. Browsers warn about a self-signed certificate; that is expected on a router.
uhttpd.subject: Subject
uhttpd.no_cert: There is no certificate yet. The web server creates one when it starts with an HTTPS listener.
uhttpd.no_generator: Neither px5g nor openssl is installed, so no certificate can be created.
uhttpd.regenerate_confirm: The web server restarts with a new self-signed certificate made from the settings below (as saved). Browsers will ask you to accept it again.
uhttpd.renewing: Creating a new certificate and restarting the web server…
uhttpd.renewed: The new certificate is in use.
uhttpd.listeners_help: Addresses and ports the web server accepts connections on: a port (80), address:port (192.168.1.1:80) or [IPv6]:port ([::]:80).
uhttpd.listener_invalid: Enter a port, address:port or [IPv6 address]:port.
uhttpd.redirect_help: Only takes effect while there is an HTTPS listener.
uhttpd.rfc1918: Ignore requests from public addresses to private ones
uhttpd.rfc1918_help: Protects against DNS rebinding attacks from the internet.
uhttpd.max_requests_help: At least 6: NuCI keeps live data streams open.
uhttpd.script_timeout_help: Longest run of one handler request; live data streams reconnect before it.
uhttpd.new_cert_help: Settings for the next self-signed certificate.
uhttpd.days_help: Browsers reject certificates valid for more than 398 days.
uhttpd.commonname_help: The name you open the router by, e.g. its host name.
